turns.content: We're about to start a kitchen renovation. Six weeks of disruption but I'm excited about the result.
Kitchen renovations are transformative. What's the main change you're making?
Opening up the wall between the kitchen and dining room to make one big space. And completely replacing the units.
That kind of structural change makes a huge difference to how a home feels. Is the wall load-bearing?
Yes, we're putting in an RSJ. The structural engineer signed off on it last week.
Good that you have that sorted before work starts. What's the unit style going for — modern, shaker?
Shaker in a dark green. I was nervous about the colour but everything I've seen online looks amazing.
Dark green is having a real moment and it works beautifully with natural wood worktops if you're going that route.
